blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A new Senate resolution urges President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to declare Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan persona non grata or ask Beijing to recall him. Sen. Risa Hontiveros filed Senate Resolution No. 746 on Tuesday, despite Malacañang’s pronouncement that Marcos does not want to declare any foreign diplomat persona non grata, as he prefers to resolve issues with other countries through diplomatic means.
